description: An empty CARDFILE: the first READ reports '10' and the loop body never displays. The dataset exists and holds no row, which is a different assertion from a case that says nothing about the dataset - only the first reaches the first-read end-of-file branch - so it is declared with "empty": true plus the CVACT02Y record length. Control is PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' at app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:74 entering its first iteration, :76 performing 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT, the READ at :93 reporting '10' so :98 moves 16 into APPL-RESULT, :104 IF APPL-AOK taking its ELSE, :107 IF APPL-EOF taking its THEN, and :108 moving 'Y' into END-OF-FILE. The guard at :77 then sees 'Y' and suppresses the DISPLAY at :78, so exactly two lines are emitted: the banners at :71 and :85. The close still runs at :83 and still reports '00', which is what makes this a normal completion with RETURN-CODE 0 rather than an error path.
